accepted_design_properties: Direct include of actual official controller in same translation unit makes anonymous Controller methods callable without copying/reimplementing them. Remove separately compiled controller to prevent duplicates;24 remaining production sources stay real.
I-L legal source created by actual parse/claim/write/cover/publish, then actual LOAD_W/QUANT/Linear/claim/publish/pair-copy with fullK1024/N3072 and all64rows.
I-L independent R0 gold from exact input and independent frozen weights; native ir_1415 is diagnostic only. Dynamic input changes and original load-before-missing-pair error priority tested.
I-V actual residual/type dual input owner data and descriptors, perturbation dependence, second bind/acquire/read/release in generated graph, binary missing-source rejection and real unary success.
Static runtime requests must use production recycle/soft-reset and real incomplete-output invalidation; separate-process tests must not claim persistent recovery.
CPU/standard-libm CSim before bounded local csynth; per-pass IR maps actual source and generated numerical/owner success path, accepts semantically correct inlining/specialization.
D2-I does not launch full64row QKV RTL, complete graph HLS or full-model RTL.
